notes: The archived C/C++/shell fixture vendors all pinned modules and registry metadata. Acceptance uses --batch, an empty repository cache and offline lockfile enforcement.
Toolchain lock describes the exact tested GCC/binutils host bytes; the resource does not bundle an entire operating-system SDK. A changed toolchain must receive its own reviewed lock.
Runtime compatibility is defined by actual architecture, ELF/GLIBC requirements and explicit host commands, not a distribution-name gate.
The Linux acceptance guard needs libseccomp; it denies fresh AF_INET and AF_INET6 sockets to the checker and all descendants. No OCI or physical-target qualification is claimed.
